Changes and ownership contract:
Exact frozen STRATA_COPY_ENGINE=1, defaultOFF. Only Prefill m.copy selects new creator. API-reported COPY/notCOMPUTE/nonzero groups, <=64 bounded discovery, same native Runtime device/context, imported immediate in-order list. Failed group creation can try another group before application submissions. Unsupported/build/backend/profiling cases remain generic with explicit fallback diagnostic.
The b9 transfer code is not copied unsafely: SYCL ownership::keep borrows; a Runtime-owned native owner retains loader and list, and EngineStream member order destroys queue before list before loader. Local queue insertion/import failures have the same ordering. Existing checked Runtime finish remains authoritative before releasing successful submissions. Destroy/close failures fail-stop. Main must verify actual UR adapter borrow/exception behavior; source compatibility alone is not proof.
Runtime::stream rejects compute use of native queues; memcpy/barrier/drain paths use stream_for_copy. copy2d parallel_for, memset, host_task, graph and fork/join operations reject. Native non-timing event_record uses barriers even with forced tag; timing tags rejected. Service-events=1 intentionally selects generic profiling queue. No new GPU waits, no concurrent host/device polling, no math/settings/slot/event/issued/credit/lifetime changes.
Frozen OFF gate returns before new queue-role mutex lookup in normal Runtime::stream/copy_only. CMake links CMAKE_DL_LIBS and adds CPU policy + manually owned GPU fixture (no GPU CTest).

Meaningful fixture scope:
CPU fixture calls actual production pure/frozen policy and checks all non-exact inputs plus immutable process setting. It is not an ownership simulation.
Runtime fixture uses tiny actual Host-USM/Device-USM arrays with full bit/canary checks and actual compute observer, copy->compute->next copy dependencies, route identity and role refusals. Active checks survive NDEBUG. Resources span catch/drain; failed drain exits retaining allocations instead of freeing pending buffers. Native unavailable/fallback returns77 and cannot be treatment PASS. Main bounded owner must enforce finite wall/log/RSS and fresh health/fault gates.

Limits and required Main review:
Ownership, compiler/link warnings, adapter interoperability and exception injection remain untested. Public raw SYCL handles are not a capability security boundary; role enforcement covers engine API paths, not malicious direct casts. Existing concurrent queue destruction/use remains forbidden. Native timing/service profiling is unavailable here by design. CPU tests do not prove loader/command-list cleanup. Main should inspect/qualify failure injection at loader, group, make_queue and insertion before model use.
Detailed SOURCE_CONTRACT.txt and MAIN_TEST_PLAN.txt include exact review/build/lint and small GPU sequence; >=32K fixed model OFF/ON only after those gates. No correctness, performance, physical bandwidth or critical-path claim. Default remainsOFF.
Target LOCAL.md and target docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md absent; applicable AGENTS and user retention read. Only new private packet/report written; previous packages, worktrees and active measurement roots untouched.
